question: What Is 2oo3 Voting Logic in Safety Instrumented Systems?
body_html:
2oo3 voting logic means two out of three: three sensors measure the same variable and the safety system trips only when at least two of them agree. A single faulty sensor cannot cause a trip or block one.

Example: with a 100 bar trip setting, readings of 105, 103 and 92 bar put two transmitters above the limit, so the system trips. It is used in ESD, BMS, HIPPS and reactor protection systems because it balances safety with plant availability.
